domains.name: AI Literacy & Adoption
domains.proves: Understanding AI and leading its use

domains.name: AI Quality & Testing
domains.proves: Testing AI systems and testing with AI

domains.name: AI Red Teaming
domains.proves: Attacking AI systems to find weaknesses

levels.name: Professional
levels.description: Roughly 1–3+ years of hands-on experience recommended.

levels.name: Expert
levels.description: Senior roles. Usually requires another certification first.

certifications.name: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Fundamentals
certifications.what: AI and generative AI concepts, responsible AI, and common workloads on Azure and Microsoft Foundry. Replaced AI-900 in 2026.
certifications.before: No prerequisites.

certifications.name: AWS Certified AI Practitioner
certifications.what: AI, ML and generative AI fundamentals, responsible AI and AWS AI services, aimed at people who work with AI rather than build it.
certifications.before: No prerequisites.

certifications.name: Google Cloud Generative AI Leader
certifications.what: Generative AI strategy and adoption for managers and decision-makers.
certifications.before: No prerequisites.

certifications.name: CompTIA AI Fundamentals
certifications.what: Vendor-neutral AI literacy: how AI works, prompt design, evaluating output and responsible use. Delivered as a course with a final assessment that earns a CompCert credential, not a standalone exam.
certifications.before: No technical background required.

certifications.name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure AI Foundations Associate
certifications.what: AI and ML basics with Oracle's AI services.
certifications.before: No prerequisites.

certifications.name: Claude Certified Associate – Foundations
certifications.what: Advising on and positioning Claude-based solutions.
certifications.before: Registration runs through the Claude Partner Network, which organisations can join for free. No formal exam prerequisites.

certifications.name: Copilot and Agent Administration Fundamentals
certifications.what: Deploying and governing Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents as an IT administrator.
certifications.before: No formal prerequisites.

certifications.name: Microsoft Certified: AI Business Professional
certifications.what: Using Microsoft 365 Copilot effectively in everyday business work.
certifications.before: No formal prerequisites.

certifications.name: Microsoft Certified: AI Transformation Leader
certifications.what: Planning AI adoption, managing risk and leading organisational change.
certifications.before: No formal prerequisites.

certifications.name: CertNexus Certified AI Practitioner (AIP-210)
certifications.what: Vendor-neutral ML lifecycle: data preparation, model training, evaluation and responsible AI.
certifications.before: No formal prerequisites. 1–3 years of hands-on practice recommended.

certifications.name: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate
certifications.what: Data preparation, model deployment, orchestration and monitoring on AWS. Transitioning to a new exam version, MLA-C02.
certifications.before: About a year of hands-on SageMaker experience recommended.

certifications.name: Microsoft Certified: Machine Learning Operations Engineer Associate
certifications.what: MLOps and GenAIOps on Azure: model deployment, monitoring and reliability at scale. Replaced DP-100.
certifications.before: Experience with Azure and ML workflows recommended.

certifications.name: Databricks Certified Machine Learning Associate
certifications.what: Core machine learning tasks on the Databricks platform.
certifications.before: Some Databricks and Python experience recommended.

certifications.name: Databricks Certified Machine Learning Professional
certifications.what: Production machine learning and MLOps on Databricks.
certifications.before: Associate-level knowledge and production experience recommended.

certifications.name: Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer
certifications.what: Designing, building and operating ML systems on Google Cloud.
certifications.before: 3+ years of industry experience recommended, including 1+ year on Google Cloud.

certifications.name: NVIDIA-Certified Professional: Accelerated Data Science
certifications.what: GPU-accelerated data science workflows.
certifications.before: 1–3 years of relevant experience recommended.

certifications.name: NVIDIA-Certified Associate: Generative AI LLMs
certifications.what: LLM fundamentals, prompting and building generative AI applications with NVIDIA tools.
certifications.before: Basic ML concepts and some Python.

certifications.name: NVIDIA-Certified Associate: Multimodal Generative AI
certifications.what: Generative AI systems that work across text, image and audio.
certifications.before: Basic ML concepts and some Python.

certifications.name: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate
certifications.what: Building generative AI apps and agents on Microsoft Foundry, plus vision, text analysis and information extraction. Replaced AI-102.
certifications.before: Python development experience and familiarity with Azure recommended.

certifications.name: Microsoft Certified: AI Agent Builder Associate
certifications.what: Designing, building and managing agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio.
certifications.before: No formal prerequisites.

certifications.name: Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate
certifications.what: Building LLM applications and RAG pipelines on Databricks.
certifications.before: Some Databricks and Python experience recommended.

certifications.name: Salesforce Certified Agentforce Specialist
certifications.what: Configuring and deploying AI agents on the Salesforce platform.
certifications.before: Salesforce platform experience recommended.

certifications.name: Claude Certified Developer – Foundations
certifications.what: Building applications with the Claude API and developer tooling.
certifications.before: Registration runs through the Claude Partner Network, which organisations can join for free. No formal exam prerequisites.

certifications.name: Claude Certified Architect – Foundations
certifications.what: Architecture decisions for production Claude applications across Claude Code, the Agent SDK, the API and MCP. Early coverage called it CCA-F.
certifications.before: Registration runs through the Claude Partner Network, which organisations can join for free. No formal exam prerequisites.

certifications.name: NVIDIA-Certified Professional: Generative AI LLMs
certifications.what: Training, fine-tuning and optimising LLMs for production.
certifications.before: 1–3 years of relevant experience recommended.

certifications.name: NVIDIA-Certified Professional: Agentic AI LLMs
certifications.what: Architecting, deploying and governing multi-agent AI systems.
certifications.before: 1–2 years in AI/ML roles with hands-on production agent projects recommended.

certifications.name: AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional
certifications.what: Integrating foundation models into applications and workflows with Amazon Bedrock, RAG and agents.
certifications.before: Hands-on AWS generative AI experience recommended.

certifications.name: Google Cloud Professional Agentic Architect
certifications.what: Designing agent-based systems on Google Cloud. Beta registration opened in September 2026.
certifications.before: Professional-level Google Cloud experience recommended.

certifications.name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Generative AI Professional
certifications.what: Building generative AI solutions on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
certifications.before: Oracle Cloud experience recommended.

certifications.name: Microsoft Certified: Agentic AI Business Solutions Architect
certifications.what: Architecting enterprise-scale, multi-agent solutions across Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry.
certifications.before: Reported to require one active Microsoft Associate certification, such as AI-103 or AB-620.

certifications.name: Claude Certified Architect – Professional
certifications.what: Advanced architecture of Claude solutions.
certifications.before: Registration runs through the Claude Partner Network, which organisations can join for free. No formal exam prerequisites.

certifications.name: NVIDIA-Certified Associate: AI Infrastructure and Operations
certifications.what: GPU and AI infrastructure fundamentals, containerised AI workloads and basic operations.
certifications.before: Basic Linux and infrastructure knowledge.

certifications.name: NVIDIA-Certified Professional: AI Infrastructure
certifications.what: Bringing up and deploying GPU systems and clusters.
certifications.before: 1–3 years of operational experience recommended.

certifications.name: NVIDIA-Certified Professional: AI Operations
certifications.what: Monitoring, optimising and troubleshooting AI workloads at scale.
certifications.before: 1–3 years of operational experience recommended.

certifications.name: NVIDIA-Certified Professional: AI Networking
certifications.what: The networking fabric that connects AI clusters, including InfiniBand, RoCE and Spectrum-X.
certifications.before: Networking experience recommended.

certifications.name: ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level
certifications.what: General software testing foundation. Not AI-specific, but required before either ISTQB AI certification.
certifications.before: No prerequisites.

certifications.name: ISTQB Certified Tester AI Testing
certifications.what: Testing AI-based systems, including ML models and LLMs, and their probabilistic, data-dependent behaviour.
certifications.before: Requires CTFL.

certifications.name: ISTQB Certified Tester Testing with Generative AI
certifications.what: Using LLMs across the test process: test design, automation, reporting and managing AI risks.
certifications.before: Requires CTFL.

certifications.name: Certified AI Security Professional
certifications.what: Hands-on AI security based on the OWASP Top 10 for LLMs and MITRE ATLAS, covering both attack and defence.
certifications.before: No formal prerequisites.

certifications.name: CompTIA SecAI+ (CY0-001)
certifications.what: Securing AI systems, AI-assisted security operations and AI governance. Launched February 2026.
certifications.before: No formal prerequisites. 3–4 years in IT and 2+ years in security recommended, with Security+ or similar.

certifications.name: GIAC AI Platform Security
certifications.what: Auditing and securing generative AI applications and LLM development pipelines. Hands-on CyberLive exam.
certifications.before: Security experience recommended. The affiliated SANS course is the usual preparation.

certifications.name: GIAC AI Security Automation Engineer
certifications.what: Applying automation and AI across offensive, defensive and cloud security operations.
certifications.before: Security experience recommended. The affiliated SANS course is the usual preparation.

certifications.name: Certified MCP Security Expert
certifications.what: Attacking and defending Model Context Protocol (MCP) deployments: tool poisoning, prompt injection, rug pulls and cross-server privilege escalation, plus hardening and monitoring. Ends in a 6-hour practical exam and a written report.
certifications.before: No formal prerequisites. Basic Linux skills needed; scripting, security fundamentals and AI familiarity help.

certifications.name: ISACA Advanced in AI Security Management
certifications.what: Running an enterprise AI security programme: governance, risk and AI security controls.
certifications.before: Requires an active CISM or CISSP.

certifications.name: Certified AI/ML Pentester
certifications.what: Practical, CTF-style exam on LLM attacks such as direct and indirect prompt injection and RAG poisoning.
certifications.before: No formal prerequisites. Exam-only; you prepare with self-study.

certifications.name: GIAC Offensive AI Analyst
certifications.what: Applying offensive AI techniques to real security problems. Hands-on CyberLive exam.
certifications.before: Offensive security experience recommended.

certifications.name: EC-Council Certified Offensive AI Security Professional
certifications.what: Red-teaming LLMs: prompt injection, model extraction, data poisoning, agent hijacking and defensive engineering.
certifications.before: Foundational cybersecurity knowledge required; EC-Council says it is not a beginner course.

certifications.name: AI Red Teaming Professional
certifications.what: Attacking and securing large language models: prompt injection, jailbreaking and AI security defences. Ends in a hands-on 24-hour exam.
certifications.before: No formal prerequisites. Familiarity with large language models, prompt injection and jailbreaking recommended.

certifications.name: Certified Agentic AI Pentester
certifications.what: Practical exam on attacking AI agents: prompt injection, tool abuse, agent hijacking and memory poisoning, based on the OWASP Top 10 for agentic applications. Launched April 2026.
certifications.before: No formal prerequisites. Two years of professional pentesting experience recommended.

certifications.name: OffSec AI Red Teamer (AI-300)
certifications.what: Attacking LLMs, multi-agent systems, RAG pipelines and AI infrastructure. Ends in a proctored 24-hour practical exam.
certifications.before: Aimed at experienced penetration testers and red teamers.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 Foundation
certifications.what: Basics of ISO/IEC 42001, the international standard for AI management systems.
certifications.before: No prerequisites.

certifications.name: IAPP Artificial Intelligence Governance Professional
certifications.what: AI governance, risk and policy across the AI lifecycle.
certifications.before: No prerequisites.

certifications.name: CSA Trusted AI Safety Expert
certifications.what: AI safety, security and governance across the model lifecycle. Developed with Northeastern University.
certifications.before: No prerequisites. Basic familiarity with AI, cloud and security recommended.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer
certifications.what: Implementing an AI management system in an organisation.
certifications.before: Management system or governance experience recommended.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Auditor
certifications.what: Auditing AI management systems against ISO/IEC 42001.
certifications.before: Audit experience recommended.

certifications.name: EC-Council Certified Responsible AI Governance & Ethics
certifications.what: Governing AI responsibly across its lifecycle: ethics, risk management, regulatory compliance, third-party risk and auditing. 100-question, 3-hour exam.
certifications.before: Requires official EC-Council training, or 2 years of information security experience plus a $100 application fee.

certifications.name: ISACA Advanced in AI Audit
certifications.what: Providing independent assurance over AI systems.
certifications.before: Requires an active CISA or another qualifying audit credential.

certifications.name: ISACA Advanced in AI Risk
certifications.what: Identifying, assessing and managing AI risk across its lifecycle. Launched April 2026.
certifications.before: Requires an active CRISC or another qualifying risk credential.
